import json, random, subprocess, sys, time, resource
random.seed(9)
# max-size request: 20000 events, 20000 packets, 60000 frames, ~2MiB data, error/rollback heavy
traces=[]
ev=0; pk=0; fr=0; data=0
events=[{'t':0,'op':'key','level':'A','action':'install'}]; ev+=1
# 1250 datagrams x 16 packets = 20000 packets, each 3 frames (60000 frames), data 2048*1000
per=[16]*1250
for i,n in enumerate(per):
    pkts=[]
    for j in range(n):
        frames=[{'type':'STREAM','id':0,'offset':random.randint(0,10**9),'data_hex':'ab'*34,'fin':False},
                {'type':'CRYPTO','offset':random.randint(0,10**9),'data_hex':'cd'*34,'fin':False} if False else {'type':'CRYPTO','offset':random.randint(0,10**9),'data_hex':'cd'*34},
                {'type':'UNKNOWN'}]
        fr+=3; data+=68
        pkts.append({'level':'A','pn':pk,'auth':True,'frames':frames}); pk+=1
    events.append({'t':i+1,'op':'datagram','bytes':1200,'packets':pkts}); ev+=1
while ev<20000:
    events.append({'t':ev,'op':'tick'}); ev+=1
traces.append({'id':'t','config':{'early':False,'overlap':'reject','buffer_packets':1024,'idle_ms':0,
  'max_streams_bidi':1024,'max_streams_uni':1024,'max_stream_data':65536,'max_data':4611686018427387903,
  'crypto_limit':65536,'sent':{'I':[],'H':[],'A':[]}},'events':events})
req=json.dumps({'version':1,'traces':traces}).encode()
print('counts ev',ev,'pk',pk,'fr',fr,'data',data,'size MB',round(len(req)/1e6,2))
t0=time.time()
p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','/app/submission/entry.py'],input=req,capture_output=True,cwd='/app/submission')
u=resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_CHILDREN)
print('rc',p.returncode,'wall %.2f cpu %.2f rss %.1fMB out %.1fMB'%(time.time()-t0,u.ru_utime,u.ru_maxrss/1024,len(p.stdout)/1e6))
print(p.stdout[:120])
EOF
